dog.description_text:
Sex: Male

Age: 7 years old

Breed: Catahoula Leopard mix

Description: medium dog with tricolor fur (brown, black and white)

Health: Spayed/neutered, Vaccinated

Temperament: Good with children and dogs, affectionate, brave, dignified, gentle, smart, friendly.

Meet Ameer! This spectacular boy was running the streets till we trapped him. While his history is a mystery we do know he was cared for at some point before ending up on the streets East NY.

He knows all his commands and loves car rides and all humans. Ameer is good with other dogs of various sizes. He is dignified and you will fall in love at first snuggle. Ameer is ready for a foster or adopter
dog.name: Ameer
